title: Schema document
description: The profile a catalog schema.json must satisfy: JSON Schema draft 2020-12, a canonical $id equal to the entity's schema URL, a required x-srn, no nested $id, and four forbidden keywords at any depth. Specified in framework/spec/kinds/datamodel.md; validated by framework/portal/src/lib/schema/registry.ts. Note that the prohibitions are stated as `not`/`required` rather than as false-valued property schemas: a schema.json may not carry a member named $anchor at any depth, and that includes the member of a `properties` map.

$schema.description: Exactly one dialect. Anything else is E_DM_DIALECT.

$id.description: The entity's canonical schema URL: the constant host followed by the entity's SRN path verbatim. No version suffix — a URL addresses the current schema. A deployment's own serving address — a localhost origin with the portal's schema-serving path under it — is E_DM_ID_MISMATCH; identity does not vary by deployment (decision-record amendment 2026-08-19-d). The address itself is not spelled here, because a catalog artifact that names one is exactly what fixture-check.test.ts forbids.

x-srn.description: The entity's unversioned SRN, stated so a schema lifted out of the catalog still says where it came from. Checked against the file's own directory, so it cannot drift from $id.

deprecated.description: The standard 2020-12 meta-data keyword. SHOULD be true at the root when the entity's frontmatter status is deprecated, so the annotation reaches consumers that only ever see the schema.

$defs.description: Entity-private. A $ref from another document into these is E_DM_FOREIGN_DEFS.

allOf.description: Root-level allOf branches that $ref other datamodels are the entire inheritance layer. There is no extends, no x-inherits, no portal-side merge directive.

no-forbidden-keywords.description: $dynamicRef and $dynamicAnchor make the inheritance graph non-static, so the portal cannot derive it. $anchor is a second way to address a local shape, and #/$defs pointers stay greppable while anchors do not. $vocabulary is dialect authoring, and the dialect is fixed. All four are E_DM_KEYWORD.

subschema.description: Any schema below the root. The four forbidden keywords are forbidden at every depth, and $id is forbidden everywhere except the root — a nested $id would re-base every reference beneath it onto a second identity, which is how one document quietly becomes two (E_DM_ID_FORBIDDEN).

reference.description: Exactly two legal forms. A local JSON Pointer into this document's own $defs, or the canonical schema URL of another datamodel in the same solution. A relative file path, an srn:// URI, a serving address or a foreign host is E_DM_REF_TARGET; a URL that leaves the solution is E_SRN_CROSS_SOLUTION; a URL naming no registered datamodel is E_SRN_DANGLING.
